body_markdown:
**WESTERLY, R.I.** – The Washington Trust Company ([Washington Trust](https://www.washtrust.com/) ) today announced that[Timothy Steiner](https://www.washtrust.com/team/timothy-steiner) has joined the Bank as vice president on its commercial and industrial (C&I) banking team. Steiner brings more than 30 years of experience with Massachusetts-based financial institutions to the role and is based in Washington Trust’s Wellesley, Mass., office.


Steiner’s addition builds on Washington Trust’s continued expansion in Greater Boston, adding C&I expertise to its Wellesley office, which also includes commercial real estate, institutional banking and wealth management. Earlier this week, the Bank announced that Brian Kenney had[joined its commercial real estate banking group](https://www.washtrust.com/news/washington-trust-expands-commercial-real-estate-banking-group-with-two-new-hires) as its first Greater Boston-based commercial real estate officer.


“Tim brings a relationship-first mindset and shares our commitment to serving clients well,” **said**[James C. Brown](https://www.washtrust.com/team/james-c-brown) **, senior executive vice president and chief commercial banking officer, Washington Trust** . “We are thrilled to have him join our growing group in Wellesley and the larger Washington Trust team.”


Prior to joining Washington Trust, Steiner held senior commercial lending and leadership roles at financial institutions in Massachusetts. His expertise spans commercial and industrial lending, commercial real estate, construction lending and equipment financing, and includes developing and managing commercial loan portfolios, structuring financing solutions and building long-term client relationships.


“Tim has spent more than 30 years working with businesses across Massachusetts and brings an extensive knowledge of the local market,” **said**[Joseph Confessore](https://www.washtrust.com/team/joseph-confessore) **, senior vice president and managing director of commercial and private banking, Washington Trust** . “His experience further strengthens our team and the personalized service we provide to businesses throughout the region.”


Steiner is a graduate of the ABA Stonier Graduate School of Banking at Wharton and attended Rutgers University.
